notes: Premise (2026-10-11, Python 3.13.2, no model): factdiff.py detect --no-save over one pack's cited sources took 0.2 s for five pinned DSC files, 1.9 s for an Autopilot question's Learn and pinned sources (unchanged) and 7.3 s for five code.claude.com pages (all changed by text hash; of the 212 facts citing them 134 verbatim, 8 modified, 5 not found, 65 unanchored), but resolved every fact citing those sources, not only the printed lines. Over the pool's answerable questions 186 of 241 printed DOC lines (77%) had a located anchor for every cited source. A moved item costs about 140 tokens (the entra replay's 43 review items were 24,212 characters). Limits: UserPromptSubmit hooks 30 s (public/claude/hooks.md:60), MCP idle 5 min (public/agents/agent-error-catalogue.csv:19), GitHub REST 60 per hour unauthenticated (public/agents/doc-change-detection.md:96), Learn one request per 1.1 s per host. Decisions D-tvjml75q and D-gmrjivyw. Planned 2026-10-12: premise is the 2026-10-11 measurement in these notes (detect resolves every fact citing a source, not only the printed lines); rag.py pack has no --revalidate flag today (rag.py pack --help). Ordered last in the sprint so it reuses ST-t2j24bhx's repository check and ST-3zlzfitj's section hashes.
